name: the styling ended: ordinary use restored
what_it_changes: Within F01, members and moderators end the prank's styling and restore ordinary use: they switch styles off, ask whether the sub has switched back, and clear what the prank left.
why: Cut rule R3 (tree-D4.md): a level-3 child of F01's key, held by 5 or more of F01's members, whose lines (read whole in _analysis/d4a01_lines_K01_addstep.txt) state a narrower change than F01's. The lines under T3-097 (switching off the prank styling) state this: 'Readers restore usable access by disabling prank styling' (minecraft); 'Users escape prank styling locally by disabling styles' (pcmasterrace); 'A moderator publicly ends the local joke period' (popheads); 'Ending the theme swap includes a later reminder to remove its leftover page title' (NieR). These are the labelers' how sentences.
